cards.text: Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, gets two pieces of news. Joshua, Israel's leader, captured Ai and did to it and its king just what he did to Jericho. And the people of Gibeon made peace with Israel and are living near them.
Adoni-zedek and his people are greatly alarmed. Gibeon is a great city, like one of the royal cities, bigger than Ai, and all its men are mighty.

cards.question: Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem is greatly alarmed about Gibeon making peace with Israel. What does he do?

answers.text: Calls four kings to help him attack Gibeon
Sends gifts to make peace with Joshua
Moves all his people out of Jerusalem

cards.text: Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon all get the message. Five Amorite kings join forces, camp before Gibeon and make war against it.

cards.question: Five armies have camped before Gibeon and made war against it. Who do the men of Gibeon send word to, begging for help?

answers.text: Joshua in the camp at Gilgal
Pharaoh king of Egypt
Hiram king of Tyre

cards.question: True or false: Joshua answers Gibeon's call by coming out from Gilgal with his whole army, mighty men of valor included.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Joshua's army is on the move toward Gibeon. What does the LORD tell Joshua?

answers.text: Don't be afraid because I've handed them over to you
Send messengers to the five kings and talk first
Take only your mighty men and leave the rest behind

cards.text: After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua catches the five kings' armies by surprise. ALL. NIGHT. I get winded hopping my gold base from one oven to the next.

cards.question: The five kings' armies are caught by surprise at Gibeon. Then the LORD throws them into ___ before Israel.

answers.text: confusion
darkness
chains

cards.text: Israel defeats them in a great slaughter at Gibeon, chases them up the ascent to Beth-horon, and strikes them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah. As they flee down from Beth-horon toward Azekah, the LORD throws large hailstones down on them from the sky.

cards.question: True or false: Israel's swords kill more of the fleeing armies than the hailstones do.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: That same day, right in front of all Israel, Joshua speaks to the LORD and calls out to the sky. What does he call for?

answers.text: The sun and moon to stand still
The stars to fall on the enemy
Dark clouds to hide the whole army

cards.text: So the sun stands still and the moon stops until the nation takes vengeance on its enemies. The writer says it's in the Book of Jashar too: "So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day."

cards.question: The writer says there has never been a day like this one, before or since. What makes it one of a kind?

answers.text: The LORD listened to the voice of a man
The LORD sent His angel before the camp
The LORD spoke aloud to the whole army

cards.text: The writer says it's because the LORD fought for Israel, and then Joshua returns with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal. But don't take that apron off yet, friend, because this story isn't finished.
